report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with low latency (62-78ms) except one 344ms outlier; logs show 200s and no errors; metrics show zero 502s and p95 checkout 425ms. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause (no 500s, no pool exhaustion, no redis timeout, no memory leak, no deployment facts). Insufficient evidence to name a bounded root cause; hand off.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency distribution for /v1/checkout to judge whether 344ms outlier is anomalous
Error/exception logs or non-200 responses correlated to the slow request
Dependency latency breakdown (order, inventory, payment, postgres, redis) for the 344ms trace
Deployment or configuration change records near the incident window
